info.title: Tenrai API
info.description:
Tenrai is a free **Unofficial** public REST API for the full MyAnimeList public catalogue. Anime, manga, characters, people, producers, seasons, and more. This API was built to satisfy the need for a more complete API, which MyAnimeList currently lacks. Implemented endpoints follow the **Jikan v4 schema**, so existing applications can point requests at this API instead of or alongside Jikan with only a base URL update. Endpoints listed as unavailable below are not part of Tenrai's compatibility surface yet. Please note that the API is in beta. There may be some issues and there will likely be some downtime here and there, but this is expected considering how new this is. Some areas may lack some polish, but we'll get to it! Thank you for being patient with us.
Patreon not yet available
--- ## Jikan v4 Notes This API does not have any user data endpoints. No club endpoints. No watch endpoints and no /userupdates for anime and manga. We may offer these endpoints in future, but for now we don't have them. We have /forum for anime but not for manga as of right now. The /forum endpoint for anime uses same schema as Jikan, however we only support episode filtering, not all or other. So you can only get the episode threads. So to clarify. /users, /watch and /clubs along with manga/forum, /getanimeuserupdates and /getmangauserupdates are not currently available. --- ## Auth & Rate Limits > Public requests work without credentials. Add `X-Server-Key` when you need higher throughput. Limits are enforced by tier. | Access | Header | RPM | RPS | RPD | |---|---|---:|---:|---:| | **Public** | *(none)* | 120 | 4 | 40,000 | | **Server Key** | `X-Server-Key` | 300 | 5 | Unlimited | Once a limit is exceeded, the API returns `429 Too Many Requests`. When you receive `429 Too Many Requests`, wait for the `Retry-After` value before retrying. Subsequent requests resume automatically after the window resets. Rate limits for public unauthenticated requests are enforced per unique IP address. ### Server Key request example Pass your Server Key in the `X-Server-Key` header: ```bash curl "https://api.tenrai.org/v1/anime/38680/full" \ -H "X-Server-Key: YOUR_SERVER_KEY" ``` Server Keys are not Bearer tokens for this API, so `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_SERVER_KEY` is not supported. Keep your Server Key in server-side code and do not expose it in browser or mobile client code. --- ## Server Keys Server Keys are private keys reserved for **[Patreon supporters](https://www.patreon.com/TenraiAPI)**. These keys offer significantly higher rate limits, making them ideal for large-scale data operations where you need to retrieve data at faster rates than the public API allows. Although referred to as "Server Keys," these are standard API keys that can be used for any project, not just servers. Whether you are running local scripts, or building your own personal databases, they are compatible with any environment. Please note that Server Key rate limits are enforced per unique key, not per IP. Consequently, they cannot be used in client-side applications like mobile apps to increase rate limits for your users. Users accessing the API through a Server Key have quicker access to recent data than public API users as Server Keys have their own separate cache. All responses are stored there for 10 mins before re-queried. > You can obtain a free temporary Server Key through our [Discord](https://discord.gg/MQ3X3sjdgK) server. --- ## SFW Filtering SFW filtering is content-based. Two filter modes are supported across SFW-capable endpoints: | Mode | Parameter | Filtered Out | |---|---|---| | **Normal SFW** | `?sfw` | `R+ - Mild Nudity`, `Rx - Hentai`, `Hentai`, `Erotica` | | **Strict SFW** | `?sfw-strict` | `R+ - Mild Nudity`, `Rx - Hentai`, `Hentai`, `Erotica`, `Ecchi` | --- ## Caching We use a dynamic caching algorithm to manage data updates. Popular, currently airing, or newly released entries are updated more frequently, while older and less active titles are cached longer. Key metrics, such as scores, member statistics, and rankings are refreshed daily. Newly added MAL entries are typically indexed and available via the API within a few hours. Because our caching system is complex and actively being optimized, you may occasionally encounter edge cases with stale data. If you notice any inconsistencies, please report them so we can make refinements. --- ## Version 2 Version 1 (v1) is only an interim version and is not the final intended version of this API. The goal of v1 is to act as a bridge between Tenrai and Jikan. Since there is no alternative to Jikan, we want to make sure there is one available. This means that v1 will not be perfectly polished, our goal is to try and transition from v1 to v2 as quickly as possible. Version 2 will be the real, actual API we wish to build and release. It'll be a gigantic upgrade over anything currently available. Whenever v2 is available, there will be several months of notice before we eventually discontinue v1. For updates, join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/MQ3X3sjdgK) server. --- ## JSON Error Response > Non-2xx error responses use a consistent JSON envelope with a machine-readable `type`, human-readable `message`, and request `path`.
Property Remarks
status HTTP status code returned for the request
type Machine-readable error category
message Human-readable explanation of what happened
error Additional context or recovery guidance
path Request path that produced the error
--- ## User Data This API only deals with public catalogue data. It does not have any endpoints for user-specific data such as profiles, animelists, or mangalists. If you need user data, then please use the [Official MyAnimeList API](https://myanimelist.net/apiconfig/references/api/v2). --- ## Usage Policy All use cases listed below should be perfectly fine: - Educational/Learning/University projects - Data Science/Research - Mobile apps/Desktop apps - Unofficial MAL clients/apps - Browser extensions/Browser scripts - Bots/Robots/Discord bots - Personal projects - Media server plugins/Metadata plugins And much much more... However, please note that we don't own the data provided by the API, so we don't really have a say in what you can and can't do. --- ## Contact To get in touch, we recommend you [Join our Discord server](https://discord.gg/MQ3X3sjdgK). If it's a personal matter or you for any reason feel like you can't or don't want to take things in Discord, then you can send an email to [contact@tenrai.org](mailto:contact@tenrai.org). Please note though that we cannot guarantee a response, but we'll try our best! Any security related issues are to be sent to [security@tenrai.org](mailto:security@tenrai.org). --- ## Disclaimer This API is provided "as is" without any warranties, express or implied. We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or availability of the data. Use of this service is at your own risk. **By using this API, you acknowledge that you are aware of, have read, and expressly agree to be bound by our [Terms of Service](https://tenrai.org/terms).** **Tenrai and this API are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by MyAnimeList.net or its parent companies in any way.** All MyAnimeList data is property of its respective owners.

Filter by rating. Multiple ratings can be selected.

* G - All Ages
* PG - Children
* PG-13 - Teens 13 or older
* R - 17+ (violence & profanity)
* R+ - Mild Nudity
* Rx - Hentai
